name: Carthage
description: The city on its headland: the Byrsa rising in terraces to the temple of Eshmun, the lower city fanning out to the sea, the round war harbour with the admiral's island and the merchant basin, the agora behind the quays, the tophet by the lagoon, the walled gardens and villas of Megara, the necropolis on the hills, and the triple wall across the isthmus.

value: Two harbours, the stepped Byrsa, the gardens of Megara and the wall across the isthmus.
